RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the April 27, 2007/Vaisakha 7, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
114
Livestock package for Kerala
*361. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Government have decided to implement a
special livestock package for three districts
in Kerala  viz. Kasaragode, Wayanad and
Palakkad with a view to provide
supplementary avenues of income to the
suicide prone farming population in these
districts;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the funds
allotted for this programme during
2007-08; and
(c) whether Government have any plan
to extend this programme to other districts
in the State and if so, the details thereof?
Debt-burden and suicide in  Punjab
*362. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
  Will the the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether a suicide census, conducted
by NGO namely 'Movement Against State
Repression', found that 1360 farmers had
committed suicide in just one district of
Punjab in a span of 17 years due to debt-
burden;
(b) if so, what is the average debt-burden
on a farmer-household in the State and how
it compares with other States and country
as a whole;
(c) the total number of such suicides in
the State during the last five years; and
(d) the steps taken to stop such suicides?
Amending the Human Organ
Transplant Act
*363. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plan to amend
the Human Organ Transplant Act, 1994 to
promote cadaver transplantation and brain
stem cell transplantation; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

115
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Decline in cultivable land
*364. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that per capita
availability of cultivable land in the country
has declined from 0.27 hectares in 1980 to
0.16 hectares in 2005;
(b) if so, how the Central Government
are persuading the States to formulate
suitable legislation to bring more and more
land under cultivation and use less
agriculture land for non-agricultural purposes
such as roads, industries, etc.; and
(c) to what extent Government's
Watershed Development Programmes such
as National Watershed Development
Project for Rainfed Areas, Soil Conservation
for Enhancing Productivity in Degraded
Lands, Integrated Wasteland Development
Programme, etc. have helped it in bringing
more and more area under cultivation?
Subsidy on export of sugar
†*365. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to give subsidy on export of
sugar;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the likely financial burden on
Government due to the same?
MSP of pulses, oil-seeds, etc.
*366. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the traders in
the country are feeding on high food prices
but the farmers are made to starve due to
Government policy of not making any
increase in the MSP of pulses, oil-seeds and
rice;
(b) whether it is also a fact that although
the price of tur dal has increased by
Rs. 4 per kg. this year, the Ministry allowed
only 10 paise per kg. increase for the
farmers; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take so that farmers in the country get a
good price for their produce?
Supply to States for distribution to
BPL people
*367. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) the total supply of wheat, sugar, rice,
kerosene made available to the State
Governments for distribution through fair
price shops for BPL people during the last
five years, State-wise and year-wise; and
(b) the total procurement of wheat, rice
and pulses made by Government agencies
during the above period at minimum support
price, year-wise?
Crop loss due to rains, hailstorm, etc.
†*368. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the crops of
wheat, mustard and green vegetables in some
parts of the country have suffered due to
unseasonal rains, hailstorm, storms and
snowfall in March, 2007;

116
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
Government to compensate the loss caused
to the farmers; and
(c) the amount, so far, provided to the
farmers by Government to take them out of
these disasters?
Plundering of coal from goods train
†*369. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:

531
Out-break of bird-flu
2727. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware
about the out-breaks of H5N1 bird-flu in
neighbouring Pakistan which is setting off
alarm bells in India;
(b) whether Government have alerted
our border States to be watchful;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have taken any
step to prevent the out-breaks of bird-flu;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Export of mangoes to America and
Japan
2728. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the United States of
America and Japan have given permission
for the export of Indian mangoes into their
market;
(b) if so, how many tonnes of mangoes
are expected to be exported to these two
countries during the current season;
(c) which varieties of mangoes, available
in Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal and Uttar
Pradesh would avail the opportunity of
export;
(d) how much foreign exchange is
estimated to be earned from the trade;
(e) whether steps have been initiated to
create awareness on quality produce and
also provide incentives to the farmers to
boost the mango exports; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Fisheries harbours on Gujarat coast
2729. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any feasibility survey was
undertaken within the last six years by the
Central Institute of Coastal Engineering for
Fishery (CICEF) for proposed fisheries
harbours on Gujarat coast;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any planning to take
up the work of new harbours during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

532
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Non-acceptance of compensation by
farmers
†2730. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
despite non-acceptance of the compensation
by farmers in various States, their land is
acquired and after expiry of the purpose of
land acquisition, the acquired lands are not
returned to them;
(b) whether Government are making
huge profits by selling the lands of the
farmers at an exorbitant rates to private
establishments and companies by converting
the use of the land so acquired;
(c) whether Government intend to bring
a Bill to give right of land to farmers and to
protect them against such arbitrariness and
exploitation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Crop loss due to heavy rains and
hailstorms
2731. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of States whose farmers
were affected due to heavy rains and
hailstorms in the recent past;
(b) the state-wise damage to standing
crops in areas due to the said hailstorms;
and
(c) whether Government are going to
provide any relief package for the farmers
who have faced heavy damage of their
standing crops and the State-wise details,
thereof?
Export and import of sugar
2732. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have allowed conditional export of two milion
tonnes of sugar;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the country is also importing
sugar; and
(d) if so, the quantity being imported and
sources thereof?
 Setting up of ADRC
2733. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for setting up of a new Agriculture
Debt Relief Commission to protect the
interests of farmers; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
 Scheme for crops production and
input management in Goa
2734. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any scheme for crops
production and input management is in force
in Goa;
(b) the details of essential features of
the scheme;
(c) the details of projects undertaken/

533
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
implemented under the scheme during the
last five years in the State; and
(d) the details of financial assistance
granted to the State during the last five years,
year-wise?
 Availability of fodder under Intensive
Milk Development Project in Kangra
†2735. SHRI HARISH RAWAT : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the arrangement to provide fodder
for she calves of the jersey breed belonging
to selected cattle-breeders under the
Intensive Milk Development Project running
in Kangr
